excluded_sources.kumazawa2003: fitted: its pH grid is a fit row of the thiol sub-model (data/lit/fit_rows/thiol_submodel.yml; parameters_sulfur 'kumazawa2003_ph_grid')

engine.wave: furanic channels (HMF, DMHF), fit wave B7

lane_networks.trunk: REACTIONS (26 steps), no pH term, no a_w term
lane_networks.sulfur: FULL_REACTIONS (114 steps) = trunk + sulfur, pH trajectory
lane_networks.acrylamide: FULL_ACRYLAMIDE_REACTIONS (42 steps) = trunk + acrylamide; sulfur STEPS deliberately absent
lane_networks.lipid: a hydroperoxide pool resolved by position (9-/13-) and geometry (cis,trans / trans,trans), decomposing first-order into Frankel 1989's six-product measured slate. The DISTRIBUTION is fitted and frozen; the RATE is a declared, bounded ASSUMPTION and every prediction says so.

lipid_lane_cointegrates.rule: direct sum with any ONE Maillard lane
lipid_lane_cointegrates.why: disjoint species sets, and the only candidate coupling (the aldehyde-lysine covalent channel) is INERT BY RULING (docs/reference/FIT_HOLDOUT_DECLARATION.md, amendment 6, ruling 2). Checked at every call by lipid.lane_coupling_verdict, not hard-coded.
lipid_lane_cointegrates.condition: revisit the moment the aldehyde-lysine Ea on food proteins is measured -- the amine pool then becomes genuinely shared
